segments.name: IoT Products & Services
segments.description: Sells wired and wireless IoT connectivity hardware and services to OEMs, enterprise and government customers.
segments.evidence: Our IoT Products & Services segment offers products and services that help original equipment manufacturers ("OEMs") as well as enterprise and government customers create and deploy secure IoT connectivity solutions.

segments.name: IoT Solutions
segments.description: Provides subscription-based condition monitoring, task management and managed network-as-a-service solutions to enterprise customers.
segments.evidence: Our IoT Solutions segment consists of our SmartSense by Digi ® business and our Managed Network–as–a-Service ("MNaaS") business acquired via our November 2021 acquisition of Ventus Wireless, LLC and affiliated entities ("Ventus").

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for one-time hardware product sales plus growing subscription-based solutions, while IoT Solutions offerings are primarily sold on a subscription model.
revenueModel.evidence: Historically the revenues from this segment have been based on one-time product sales. More recently we have placed greater emphasis on selling subscription-based solutions across this product portfolio.

changes.text: In fiscal 2025 the company acquired Jolt Software, Inc. to enhance the SmartSense by Digi offerings in the IoT Solutions segment.
changes.evidence: During the fourth quarter of fiscal 2025 we completed the acquisition of Jolt Software, Inc. to enhance the offerings of SmartSense by Digi.
